summary: Sandbach United secured three points in today's match against Wedsfield CFC, though it wasn't without drama as a substitution mix-up temporarily left the Bach down to ten men due to the new rule regulations. Despite the administrative hiccup, the lads managed to see out the win against their visitors from the North West Counties Football League. It was a good day all round with a positive result and some friendly opposition making the trip to Sandbach.
